title: Finite Element Analysis of Maxwell's Equations with Time-Varying Coefficients and Nonlinear E-H Coupling: Convergence and Exponential Decay
summary: This paper analyzes finite element approximations for Maxwell's equations with time-dependent coefficients and nonlinear E-H coupling in both the total current density and the Silver-Müller-type boundary condition. The nonlinear coupling and the time-varying material parameters prevent the use of standard analytical tools, including the discrete compactness property and the Minty-Browder argument, making the numerical analysis particularly challenging.
